description: Rank live Hyperliquid perpetual markets by funding rate, funding APR, open interest, 24h volume or 24h change. Covers core Hyperliquid perps and a reviewed set of HIP-3 markets. New issues and pre-IPO markets are excluded. Default: the 25 markets with the most extreme funding APR, concise fields. Ask for limit, sort, coins, or DETAILED only when you need them. The full set is about 13k tokens. Result carries `provenance` (upstream endpoint, request, fetch time). For educational purposes only. Not trading advice. Not investment advice. Independent. Not affiliated with Hyperliquid Labs or the Hyperliquid Foundation.

coins.description: Restrict to symbols, e.g. ["BTC","ETH"]. No -PERP suffix.

dir.description: Direction; `asc` on fundingAprPct surfaces the most negative funding first.

response_format.description: CONCISE (default): coin, mark, fundingAprPct, oi, vol. DETAILED: every field.

sort.description: Ranking key. Funding, premium and change sort by magnitude by default.
